items.name: 1. Spec Compliance
items.note: Hono floor raised to the fix line 4.12.34; ADR records the drift-prevention decision (final: option (a) + narrow pinned test, after the architecture-review pass rejected the initially-built registry mechanism); test asserts the constraint on the declared range with fail-before/pass-after proof. No other profiles touched (out of scope).

items.name: 2. Error Handling
items.note: No runtime error-handling surface in this diff (a JSON config value, a doc-string edit, and a pytest test have no request/DB/external-call boundary).

items.name: 3. Security Basics
items.note: No user input, no secrets; a dependency-floor bump and a pinned regression test.

items.name: 4. Test Quality
items.note: 2 tests assert on outcomes (the real profile's declared floor; a fail-before comparison), one happy-path + one regression-proof, both independently runnable, both PASSED.

items.name: 5. Performance Basics
items.note: No loops, no I/O beyond reading one small JSON file.

items.name: 6. Naming & Structure
items.note: test_profile_dependency_floors.py lives in shared/tests alongside the other tests that already read shared/profiles/*.json; well under the 300-LOC cap.

items.name: 7. Affected Boundaries
items.note: No new serialized producer/consumer format - the test reads an existing profile JSON that no other component writes.

items.name: 8. Test Hygiene Probe
items.note: uv run shared/scripts/tools/scan_test_hygiene.py --diff -> 'no findings' (re-run after the mechanism was simplified).
